name: Agents from anywhere
description: Any AI tool or agent platform as a member of an organization: command-line agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, or any command) and agents behind an HTTP API (Grok and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints, A2A agents, plain webhooks). They get the same messages, tasks and flow steps as Pantheon's own agents, and Pantheon's tools through MCP.
